detailed_description: The Random Color Generator creates a browser-side palette of random colors with copyable HEX, RGB, or HSL output. Set the number of swatches from 1 to 20, choose the output format, press Generate, and click any color card to copy its current value. Copy All returns the complete palette in the selected format, while Palette Preview shows the generated colors together as a single strip. It is useful for quick design inspiration, placeholder palettes, art prompts, and testing color values without installing a design app.
usage_steps: Set how many random colors to generate, from 1 to 20.
Choose HEX, RGB, or HSL as the displayed copy format.
Click Generate to replace the current swatches with a new random palette.
Click any color card to copy that color value.
Use Copy All to copy the full palette in the selected format and check Palette Preview to see the colors side by side.
usage_examples: Generate five HEX colors for a quick website mockup.
Switch to RGB output before pasting values into a CSS prototype.
Create a random palette strip for art direction notes or copy all HSL values for a design experiment.

faqs.question: How many colors can I generate?
faqs.answer: You can generate 1 to 20 random color swatches at a time.

faqs.question: Which color formats are supported?
faqs.answer: The same palette can be copied as HEX, RGB, or HSL values.

faqs.question: Can I copy one color instead of the whole palette?
faqs.answer: Yes. Click an individual color card to copy that value, or use Copy All for the full list.

faqs.question: Does it check color contrast?
faqs.answer: No. This generator only creates random colors and copyable values, so review readability separately before using a palette in a final interface.

faqs.question: Are palettes saved?
faqs.answer: No. Generate and copy the values you want before leaving the page.
